_about_en: Teaching packs are written by My Culture Connect to go with Dom Jones's lesson plans. Dom chooses the week's power vocabulary; the Chinese, the examples and the practice sets here are ours, so that a teacher can run her plan with no preparation. Kept in a separate file from data/lesson-plans.json so that re-importing Dom's PDF never overwrites our additions, and so it stays obvious which words are whose.
_about_zh: 教學包由人師教育協會編寫，搭配 Dom Jones 的教案使用。每週的核心字彙是 Dom 選的；這裡的中文、例句與練習是我們加的，目的是讓老師不必備課就能把她的教案上完。刻意與 lesson-plans.json 分檔，重新匯入 Dom 的 PDF 不會蓋掉我們加的東西，也一眼看得出哪部分是誰寫的。

1.prep_en: No preparation needed. Read the lightning round off the screen. Students need one sheet of paper for their Word Bank.
1.prep_zh: 不必備課。中翻英練習直接照螢幕唸。學生只需要一張紙做自己的單字銀行。

words.example: Let me introduce myself — my name is Yi-Chen and I play basketball.
Tell me about one experience you had this summer.
Speaking English for sixty seconds is my challenge today.
This year I want to improve my listening.
She felt confident when she answered in English.
Good learners stay curious — they always ask why.
What is your favorite food in your hometown?
Today you will discover how many English words you already know.

practice.note_en: For the 35–50 min speed round. Read the Chinese, students race to say the English. All eight words appear.
practice.note_zh: 搭配 35–50 分鐘的 Speed Round。唸中文，學生搶答英文。八個字全部出現。
items: 我想介紹我的家人。 → I want to introduce my family.
那是一次很棒的體驗。 → That was a great experience.
這對我來說是一個挑戰。 → This is a challenge for me.
我想改善我的發音。 → I want to improve my pronunciation.
她說英文的時候很有自信。 → She is confident when she speaks English.
我對你的暑假很好奇。 → I am curious about your summer.
你最喜歡的科目是什麼？ → What is your favorite subject?
我今天發現了一個新單字。 → I discovered a new word today.

practice.title_zh: 六十秒自我介紹・句型架構
practice.note_en: Put these on the board. A1 students fill in two frames; B1 and above should link them into one flowing minute.
practice.note_zh: 寫在白板上。A1 學生填兩句就好；B1 以上要把句子串成流暢的一分鐘。
items: My name is ______ and my favorite ______ is ______.
One experience I will never forget is ______.
This year I want to improve my ______.
I feel confident when I ______.
I am curious about ______.

practice.note_en: Two teams. Say the word, the other team must answer with a synonym or an opposite.
practice.note_zh: 分兩隊。唸出單字，另一隊要接出同義詞或反義詞。
items: confident ↔ nervous / shy
curious ↔ bored
improve ↔ get worse
discover ≈ find out
challenge ≈ difficult task
favorite ≈ the one I like best

practice.note_en: Dom's plan asks every student to produce something before leaving. This is the smallest version that still counts.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的教案要求每個學生離開前都要產出東西。這是最小、但仍然算數的版本。
items: Today I discovered that I already know about ______ English words.
This year I want to improve my ______.
